create_gcs_import_storage: create a GCS import storage connection for importing tasks from Google Cloud Storage
list_gcs_import_storage: list all GCS import storage connections filtered by project ID
update_gcs_import_storage: update a specific GCS import storage connection by its ID
delete_gcs_import_storage: delete a specific GCS import storage connection by its ID
sync_gcs_import_storage: sync tasks from a GCS import storage connection by its ID
